meta.notes: The app tags it "YUANDAO DSP Device" and files it under YUANDAO; it is sold as a NiceHCK product, so that is its brand here. Its official presets: 1 Default (flat), 2 Tears, 3 Rock Live, 4 POP, 5 ACG, 6 Balance, 7 Tuned by DSP Master, 8 bands each, with pre-gains from -2 to +3 dB. Its USB product name has no brand: "10th Anniversary Edition". Like the PureAural it leaves stale bytes in its answers, so the app shows its firmware as "0.".
